title: Melt-quench AIMD simulation and structure relaxation
action: Using Quantum ESPRESSO with an LDA PAW pseudopotential for carbon, perform constant-volume ab initio molecular dynamics for a system of 120 carbon atoms at a target mass density of 1.50 g/cm³. Start from random coordinates, heat to 8000 K, equilibrate, melt-quench to 300 K over 15 ps, and finally perform conjugate-gradient relaxation. Output the fully relaxed atomic structure.
description: Relaxed atomistic structure in XYZ format. The checker will recompute mean coordination number and sp/sp²/sp³ fractions using a bond cutoff and compare to hidden paper values for model c120_15ps.
output_schema: XYZ format text: first line = number of atoms N; second line = a comment string (e.g., cell vectors); next N lines each contain symbol 'C' followed by three space-separated Cartesian coordinates in Angstrom.

title: Vibrational eigenfrequency calculation
action: Using the relaxed structure from step_01, perform single-point force calculations with Quantum ESPRESSO for each atom displaced by ±0.015 Å along x, y, and z directions to construct the force constant matrix. Diagonalize the matrix to obtain vibrational eigenfrequencies. Output the non-zero frequencies.
description: List of non-zero vibrational eigenfrequencies in cm⁻¹. The checker will Gaussian broaden these to compute VDOS and harmonic specific heat Cv(T) and verify that Cv(300 K) approaches the Dulong-Petit limit while checking VDOS shape characteristics.
output_schema: One eigenfrequency per line, in cm⁻¹, as a floating-point number. Sorted ascending. First three zero-frequency translation modes may be omitted; total lines = 3N-3 where N is the number of atoms.

title: Radial distribution function computation
action: From the relaxed atomic structure in step_01, compute the radial distribution function g(r) up to at least 6 Å with fine spacing. Output the g(r) data.
description: Radial distribution function data. The checker will locate the first and second peaks and verify their positions against hidden paper values.
output_schema: Two comma-separated columns: r (Angstrom) and g(r) (dimensionless). No header row. At least 300 rows covering r from 0 to 6 Å.

title: Electronic density of states calculation
action: Perform a single-point electronic-structure calculation on the relaxed structure from step_01 to obtain the total and p-orbital projected density of states. Align the energy scale to the Fermi level, and output the data covering at least the range -10 eV to +10 eV.
description: Electronic density of states data. The checker will inspect the total and p-projected DOS near the Fermi level for a pseudogap and p-orbital dominance, consistent with paper expectations.
output_schema: Three comma-separated columns: energy (eV, relative to Fermi level), total DOS (arbitrary normalized), p-orbital projected DOS (same normalization). No header or header optional. At least 200 rows covering -10 to +10 eV.
